title: F6: the outcome of one verify-before-save teaching-loop attempt
description: Built by clozn.runs.teaching_loop.verify_and_promote(). A teaching-loop promotion (as opposed to a user hand-confirming their own correction via clozn.runs.corrections.confirm_correction()) is a THREE-step, receipt-carrying claim: a target failure run (the recorded bad outcome), a child retry run (the SAME situation replayed with a drafted, not-yet-confirmed clozn.correction.v1 in effect), and an exact, model-free comparison between them using clozn.replay.controlled.match_run() -- the SAME comparison primitive `compare-runs --test` already uses, never a second implementation of it. `target_run_id`/`child_run_id` are the verification pair: both are exact ids of already-persisted, immutable runs, so anyone can re-read either run independently and check this document's claim for themselves -- never a bare 'verified: true' boolean. `verification` records what the comparison showed (`passed`: the child run did NOT reproduce the target failure under `match_criterion`; `failed`: it did, or the evidence needed to tell was unavailable on one side). `promoted` is true only when `verification` is `passed` AND the correction was still an unconfirmed, non-deleted draft at the moment this ran -- see clozn.runs.teaching_loop's module docstring for the exact mechanism that makes a promoted document impossible to construct without a real, checkable pair. A `failed` verification is never discarded: it is written to the SAME correction_events ledger clozn.correction-export.v1 already exposes (event_type `verification_failed`), so a correction clozn tried and could not verify stays visible as evidence, not silently dropped, and the draft it names remains exactly that -- a draft, never auto-promoted.

target_run_id.description: The recorded failure this teaching-loop attempt tried to fix -- an exact, already-persisted run id, never free text.

child_run_id.description: The retry run compared against target_run_id -- an exact, already-persisted run id. F6 does not execute this retry itself (out of scope; see the module docstring): it is supplied as evidence, not generated here.

match_criterion.description: The same closed vocabulary clozn.replay.controlled.SUPPORTED_MATCHERS declares -- exact recorded evidence only, never a semantic-similarity judgment.

comparison.description: The verbatim return value of clozn.replay.controlled.match_run(child_run, target_run, match_criterion) -- deliberately NOT re-modeled field-by-field here (its `actual`/`expected` shape varies by criterion; see that function's own docstring), so this schema never drifts out of sync with the one comparison implementation it reuses.

available.description: False when the match criterion's evidence could not be read from one or both runs -- a verification can never be 'passed' in that case, regardless of any other field.

verification.description: 'passed': comparison.available is true and comparison.matched is false -- the child run did not reproduce the recorded target failure. 'failed': either the evidence was unavailable, or the child run matched the target failure exactly (the correction changed nothing observable).

promoted.description: True only when verification is 'passed' AND the correction was confirmed by this call. A 'failed' verification is never promoted; a correction that was already confirmed before this call is refused outright (see clozn.runs.teaching_loop.TeachingLoopStateError) rather than silently re-promoted.

correction.description: The resulting clozn.correction.v1 document as currently stored -- still a draft (confirmed_ts absent) when promoted is false, confirmed when promoted is true. Embedded rather than $ref'd: this validator only follows local #/$defs refs (clozn/schemas/_validator.py), and the document was already produced by clozn.runs.corrections' own row->document construction, which is schema-validated at the point a correction is first drafted.
